But in the days of the Great Depression, there was a different way of life: A time when food was simple, uncomplicated, and inexpensive. We didn’t have Instagram to boast about our new-fangled “food porn”; we had our Grandma, and she had a whole lot of ways to make a meal that would make your mouth water.
